name: deguboard
description: Git-native な AI ワークフローとチケット管理。CLI は dg

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: tsc -b tsconfig.build.json && cp packages/cli/src/guide-*.md packages/cli/dist/ && pnpm --filter @deguboard/web build && rm -rf packages/cli/web && cp -r packages/web/dist packages/cli/web && pnpm --filter deguboard-vscode build
scripts.pack: rm -rf release && pnpm --filter @deguboard/core --filter @deguboard/server --filter deguboard exec pnpm pack --pack-destination ../../release
